phase: P1 tenth increment: durable frozen candidate consumption and audited queue acknowledgement; read-only disk audit
implemented: Immutable first-writer candidate association with bounded canonical evidence, full binding and original signal digest. No evaluation or new snapshot on retry.
Receipt-first recovery verifies permanent intent or negative proof before consulting a new candidate/current deployment. Missing, corrupt, foreign and orphan records do not become ignored signals.
New OPEN uses existing atomic StrategySignalAdmission and StrategyPrepareRecovery. Duplicate signal terminal proof does not prepare the winner again.

Own IGNORED/EXPIRED terminal is evidence-backed and atomic under signal lock, verifies the original frozen candidate, and uses PostgreSQL time for expiry. Unknown admission failures are not converted into terminal outcomes.

Typed scheduler requires a verified safe result plus committed business evidence before ACK. Legacy bulk expiry cannot be used with typed worker. Unknown order remains with order recovery; order-free UNKNOWN intent remains pending.
Settled replay requires current accounting_revision and USDT journal, not just any prior settlement row.

Offline and separately guarded online reference-index scripts add v2_s3_frames(state_id,state_version); wrong or invalid same-name index fails without automatic DROP. Online script is not executed on running database.

qa.boundary: One isolated temporary PostgreSQL 16 and Redis harness at a time. Unix sockets, dedicated V2 conftest external TCP denial. No exchange calls, runtime credentials or runtime schema changes.

selected_regression.note: Full rerun of the 25 selected related files after fixture corrections. This is not all repository tests, live process-group acceptance, a venue end-to-end run or strategy profitability validation.

intermediate_runs.scope: Entry store/worker/scheduler combined before final fixture fixes
intermediate_runs.correction: Tests attempted financial UNKNOWN setup with risk policy absent or initialized after preparing an unreserved episode. Risk/capital configuration now precedes admission and financial fixtures use actual scoped risk reference. Production safety checks were not weakened.

covered_faults: First-writer replay, immutable candidate, source/account scope, signal/time/plan digests, damaged evidence and unsafe credentials/feature payloads
Receipt priority after candidate loss or deployment change; original order identity retained
Admission, preparation and negative terminal commit acknowledgement lost, verified retry without extra intent/order
Actual ACK transaction rollback and committed-ACK response loss, lease-token protection, no false completion

Order-free UNKNOWN remains pending; existing UNKNOWN order is not reposted or falsely resolved
Expired duplicate keeps original duplicate reason; first expiry requires original frozen proof
Stale settlement revision does not count as current settlement completion
Reference-index repeat migration, exact index identity, invalid/wrong index retained on failure, exact-version and cross-environment reference protection
Unforced planner selects reference index with 24000 wide unrelated frames; retention preview/apply within original five-second budget for that isolated sample

disk.diagnosis: Diagnostic retention candidate SELECT times out before deleting. EXPLAIN shows unindexed reverse reference anti-join scanning roughly 10.4 million S3 frames. Broader PG growth remains outside the current narrow retention whitelist.
disk.note: Only this turn's disposable QA databases were removed by the established isolated harness. No live accounting/evidence, logs, releases, user files or other project data were deleted. No reliable daily growth series or reclaimable-space estimate is claimed.
